acceptance.note: Acceptance binds the RECOMMENDED design (D_ROOT_NS: privileged anchor namespace). A_CONTRACT is the r5 baseline, retained to show the trust-root defect deterministically. E_SIGNED and F_VERITY are modeled to expose exactly which traces a signature root and an fs-verity root do and do not close.
